summary: Unsealed lane end beside parked cars; homes 11-16 m away all round.
reasons: Cars parked at the Kinloch St end
Dirt lane with a vehicle on it

best_section.where: Start of the dirt lane at the Kinloch Street corner, by the parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 16 m and 27 m from the first 10 m, with more homes within 25 m on both sides; not secluded.
drivers.access_and_room: Dirt and grass strip meets the street; a car sits on the lane, so a van can pull off the road.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; the larger road to the west is out of earshot of the start.
drivers.convention: Several cars park along Kinloch Street here, so a van would not stand out much.

flags: Steep: about 6% over the first 10 m, 3.5% mean
Low-lying: 7-9 m elevation, Witton Creek 57 m away
Lane looks like a private drive between lots; ownership unclear
sun_shade: Open at the street end; tree shade from the north-west, house shade late afternoon.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is private or an unformed road
